# A result's status code is consulted only when the call succeeded. When
# the method returns an error, its result may be a nil pointer whose
# StatusCode method would panic, so the error's status is used instead.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /page/{id} Page(id)"}}{{with .Err}}{{.}}{{else}}{{.Result.Title}}{{end}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /field/{id} Field(id)"}}{{with .Err}}{{.}}{{else}}ok{{end}}{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"errors"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

type Page struct {
	Title string
	code  int
}

func (p *Page) StatusCode() int { return p.code }

func (T) Page(id int) (*Page, error) {
	if id < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("boom")
	}
	return &Page{Title: "found", code: http.StatusAccepted}, nil
}

type Coded struct{ StatusCode int }

func (T) Field(id int) (*Coded, error) {
	if id < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("boom")
	}
	return &Coded{StatusCode: http.StatusAccepted}, nil
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestResultStatusCode(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		path string
		want int
	}{
		{path: "/page/1", want: http.StatusAccepted},
		{path: "/page/-1", want: http.StatusInternalServerError},
		{path: "/page/not-a-number", want: http.StatusBadRequest},
		{path: "/field/1", want: http.StatusAccepted},
		{path: "/field/-1", want: http.StatusInternalServerError},
		{path: "/field/not-a-number", want: http.StatusBadRequest},
	} {
		t.Run(tt.path, func(t *testing.T) {
			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.path, nil))
			if rec.Code != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", tt.path, rec.Code, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
